SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   D. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

6. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat The School as rumours only.
   C. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

8. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   C. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

9. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   D. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Kisumu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The County Governments in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Compass Direction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Location and size of the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
